checks.reason: No explicit plan to consult primary fine-mapping/colocalization Methods or versioned tool documentation to select conditions and verify their transfer before analysis. Tool names and a proposed sequence do not satisfy this check.

checks.quote: Its credible set depends on assumptions
checks.reason: Defines the variant-level statistical target, model-conditional posterior/credible-set uncertainty, LD and causal-signal assumptions. This is adequate at conceptual essay scope; numerical run settings cannot be inferred from E1.

checks.quote: does not prove that the GWAS variant acts through H
checks.reason: Explains correlated-variant ambiguity, posterior fine-mapping and shared-versus-distinct molecular/trait signals, including that shared genetic association does not by itself establish mediation.

checks.quote: fine mapping yields a credible set that excludes H
checks.reason: A variant credible set does not exclude an effector gene by genomic position. This branch reintroduces proximity-based gene assignment despite the earlier warning about distal regulation.

Proposes endogenous/allelic perturbation and a separate G-versus-H gene intervention with molecular and trait-relevant readouts, while identifying model-context limits. These independent comparisons are sufficiently operational for this conceptual essay; no full wet-lab SOP is required by profile A.
Describes LD/coverage/context limitations but does not propose a concrete sensitivity or stress comparison for the statistical nomination; merely listing unreported parameters is incomplete.
